$sources: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 87, 88: the wind pressure and the seismic force carry no importance factor
source: The Building Standard Law sets one level for every building: I = 1.0 in all four SAEngine categories (I to IV). Higher levels some owners ask for (e.g. the government buildings' seismic standard, 1.25 or 1.5) are not the law's: enter them under Code Values for the project.

I.description: Buildings of low hazard to human life (agricultural, temporary)

III.description: Buildings of many occupants (schools, assembly halls)

IV.description: Essential facilities (hospitals, fire and police stations, disaster headquarters)

sources.categories: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 87 and 88 have no importance factor: 1.0 for every category (SAEngine keeps its four categories for the other modules)
